lines.zh: 拖着腐烂的身体向前挪动。
lines.en: Drag its rotting body forward.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指在泥土中摸索。
lines.en: Rotting fingers dig in the dirt.
It shuffles closer to the player.
Its stiff legs drag on the ground.

lines.zh: 腐烂的血液滴在地面上。
lines.en: Rotten blood drips onto the ground.
It moves slowly but resolutely.

lines.zh: 腐肉覆盖的肌肉颤抖着。
lines.en: Its flesh-covered muscles tremble.
The rotting corpse moves slowly.

lines.zh: 腐臭的呼吸声在空气中回荡。
lines.en: Its stinking breath hangs in the air.

lines.zh: 它试图用腐烂的手抓住你。
lines.en: It tries to grab you with its rotting hand.
A broken leg dragging, I still crawl on.
Limping, I follow the living.
It stands still, rotting.
It stands precariously in place.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肉从骨架上剥落。
lines.en: Rotten flesh peels off its skeleton.

lines.zh: 它的目光呆滞地望着前方。
lines.en: Its lifeless eyes stare ahead.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤紧贴着骨头。
lines.en: Rotten skin clings to the bones.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肌肉在风中摇晃。
lines.en: Its rotting muscles sway in the wind.

lines.zh: 它腐烂的体味弥漫开来。
lines.en: Its stench permeates the air.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肉在风中摆动。
lines.en: Its rotting flesh sways in the breeze.
Rotten blood seeps from the wounds.

lines.zh: 腐烂的骨头发出嘎吱声。
lines.en: Rotten bones creak.
A bubbling sound squeezes from my throat.

lines.zh: 我啃着自己的手指发呆。
lines.en: I chew my own fingers and stare.

lines.zh: 我的半边脸垂着一动不动。
lines.en: Half my face sags, utterly still.
I scratch the dirt as if counting.
It suddenly locks on to the player.

lines.zh: 我一出现，尸群就跟着来。
lines.en: Where I appear, the horde follows.
Its gaze lingers on you.
Its eyes pass over you.
It stares at you without moving.

lines.zh: 它的目光死死地盯着你。
lines.en: Its eyes fix on you.

lines.zh: 它的视线在你周围游移。
lines.en: Its gaze wanders around you.
Its gaze follows you closely.
Its sight locks onto you.

lines.zh: 它的目光似乎穿透了你。
lines.en: Its gaze seems to pierce through you.

lines.zh: 我的腐眼转过来，没焦点。
lines.en: My rotten eyes turn, unfocused.
My nostrils twitch at the smell of the living.
I tilt my head to hear your heart.
I bring my face closer.
Worms crawl in my eye sockets.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出低低的咕噜。
lines.en: A low gurgle rolls from my throat.

lines.zh: 我腐烂的鼻子记下了你的汗。
lines.en: My rotten nose has filed away your sweat.
My mouth corner pulls upward.

lines.zh: 膝盖反着弯，我还往前挪。
lines.en: My knee bends backward, and I keep dragging forward.
The horde isn't all here yet. Patience.

lines.zh: 我的胸口被劈开，风灌进去。
lines.en: My chest is split open and wind blows through.
Go away!
Please, spare me!
Ow, it hurts!

lines.zh: 我半张脸掉了下来，还站着。
lines.en: Half my face fell off, and I am still standing.
Let go of me!
Help me, I'm in pain!
Please, let me go!

lines.zh: 我闻到了你的血，腐烂的家伙。
lines.en: I smell your blood, rotten thing.
Hurry, don't make me wait long.
You have what I want.

lines.zh: 过来，一起分享这世界的痛苦。
lines.en: Come, share the world's pain.
Your scent makes me salivate.
You suit as my new partner.
Don't move, let me get close.
Enjoy my proximity.
Your resistance is futile.
I am your destiny.
The horde is behind me — you can't stop it.
Move, let me pass.
Don't force me to act.

lines.zh: 尸群从我身后挤过来，让。
lines.en: The horde pushes past from behind me; move.
Make way for me.
Don't force me to attack you.

lines.zh: 你站在我和活人之间了。
lines.en: You are standing between me and the living.
Get out of my way.
Step back, or you'll die.
Move, or I'll attack.
Fight together until victory.
Find new companions.
Survive with me.
We need more of our kind.
Let the horde gather. A sort of company.
Fight enemies together.

lines.zh: 腐烂的牙印就是同伴的记号。
lines.en: A rotten bite mark is the sign of kin.
Grow together.

lines.zh: 一起啃同一具尸体，就算成家。
lines.en: Sharing one corpse is family enough.
Face the future together.

lines.zh: 饥肠辘辘的尸群成员出现！
lines.en: A hungry horde member appears!
There's food nearby, it's looking for it.

lines.zh: 尸群中的一员在寻找猎物。
lines.en: A horde member is searching for prey.
It smells the scent of food.
A horde member is foraging.
It craves to consume everything.
A horde member starts foraging.
It searches for food in the rotting meat.

lines.zh: 尸群成员在腐败的环境中觅食。
lines.en: A horde member forages in the corrupt environment.
It tracks the scent of food.
It acquires a target.

lines.zh: 尸群成员发现了新的猎物。
lines.en: A horde member finds new prey.

lines.zh: 它发现了潜在的食物来源。
lines.en: It discovers a potential food source.

lines.zh: 尸群成员开始追踪猎物。
lines.en: A horde member starts tracking prey.
It approaches the target.
It locks and tracks the target.

lines.zh: 尸群成员找到了一个目标。
lines.en: A horde member finds a target.

lines.zh: 我朝你的脚踝伸出一只手。
lines.en: I reach one hand toward your ankle.
It has acquired the target.

lines.zh: 尸群成员正在瞄准猎物。
lines.en: A horde member aims at the prey.
A living one, fresher than carrion.
I take the first step toward you.

lines.zh: 我的同伴也闻到那股味。
lines.en: My kin catch the same scent.
I have decided you can be eaten.
Prey, and the living kind.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的声音变成嘶吼。
lines.en: The sound in my throat turns into a snarl.
It wants to devour the prey.
It's preparing to attack the prey.
It's going to get closer to the prey.
It's targeting the prey.
It's preparing to bite the prey.
It wants to eat the prey.
It wants to kill the prey.
It's going to gnaw on the prey.
It's going to eat the prey.
It's going to tear the prey apart.
I raise my hand to my chest.
I measure the distance for a lunge.
I grind my teeth audibly.
I settle on your neck.

lines.zh: 我拖着的腿忽然收紧了。
lines.en: My dragging leg suddenly tightens.
My kin spread into a half circle.

lines.zh: 我把手爪对准你的后背。
lines.en: I line my claws up with your back.

lines.zh: 我屏住一口不存在的气。
lines.en: I hold a breath I no longer have.
Horde level two — all follow me.

lines.zh: 我的指甲先抠进你的衣领。
lines.en: My nails dig into your collar first.
Move, or I'll eat you!
Bite your flesh!

lines.zh: 我抓住你袖子，腐肉蹭上去。
lines.en: I grab your sleeve; rot smears across it.
Your flesh is mine!
Hiding won't help!
My claws will slice you!
You'll be my meal!
Tear out your throat!

lines.zh: 我的指甲抠进你的胳膊！
lines.en: My nails dig into your arm!
I slam my forehead into your nose!
I lock my teeth on your shoulder!

lines.zh: 我两只手一起扯你衣领！
lines.en: Both my hands yank your collar!
I drop on you and bear you down!

lines.zh: 我的断指抠进了你的伤口！
lines.en: A broken finger of mine digs into your wound!
More zombies are spawning!
More horde are coming!

lines.zh: 我们数量庞大，难以抵挡！
lines.en: We're too many to stop!
More zombies appear!
They come in the darkness!
The horde is about to break!
Prepare for more horde!
More zombies, about to spawn!
The summon is here!
More zombies are coming!

lines.zh: 我从翻起的泥土里伸出手。
lines.en: I push my hand out of the broken soil.
I walk out of the woods with the others.

lines.zh: 我聚到你身后的尸群里。
lines.en: I gather into the horde behind you.
I scratch from under the soil.
The stench arrives first, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我第一个站起来，还有更多。
lines.en: I rise first, and more follow.
I take shape out of the fog, step by step.
The whole area suddenly goes quiet.
I'm burning!

lines.zh: 一整群从二楼掉了下来。
lines.en: A whole horde fell off the second floor.
Water to my knees — the horde is sinking.

lines.zh: 这一下把我半张脸都炸没了。
lines.en: That blast took half my face.

lines.zh: 箭插在肩上，尸群还在来。
lines.en: Arrow in my shoulder, the horde keeps coming.

lines.zh: 那道光烧穿了我的肩胛。
lines.en: That light burned through my shoulder blade.
I'm starving to death!

lines.zh: 雷一响，我身后的尸群更兴奋。
lines.en: Thunder only excites the horde behind me.
Darkness of the void!
